title: Foot Chase Ends With Oklahoma City Officer Shooting Armed Suspect
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Oklahoma City, Oklahoma — On January 1, 2025, shortly after 1:30 a.m., the Oklahoma City Police were summoned to a domestic call involving a firearm at a residence in the 1400 block of SW 30th St. The person who called 911 reported the suspect, Miguel Hernandez, had broken a window to the residence and was outside firing shots. As officers arrived, Hernandez fled on foot, still armed with a pistol. It was during the foot chase that Hernandez turned toward the pursuing officer and was subsequently shot by Officer Umphreys. Hernandez suffered a non-life-threatening gunshot wound to one of his ankles. He was transported to an area hospital where he was treated and released. He was later booked into the Oklahoma County Detention Center on a complaint of possession of a firearm after adjudication.
